next.reason: No implementation task is currently valid. Use the accepted loop on at least five real JavaScript exercises and record non-sensitive observations before deciding whether JPL-004 should exist.

ownerSummary.whatIsBeingBuilt: A private local JavaScript practice loop that preserves attempts, reflection and fresh retries without turning into an answer generator.
ownerSummary.whyThisTaskNow: JPL-003 was accepted. The correct next step is real use, not another feature, because the proposed history slice depends on observing repeated mistakes across at least five exercises.
ownerSummary.whatNotToDo: Do not build JPL-004 labels, grouping, analytics, scheduling, AI, backend, authentication or sync before the evidence threshold is met and reviewed.
ownerSummary.whatComesAfter: After at least five real exercises, review the observations and either activate a bounded JPL-004, reshape it, or drop it.
